concept.title: Multi-Language Support
concept.shortdesc: In addition to English, X-Author for Excel is also available in the Japanese (Nihongo) language.

conbody.p: In addition to English, X-Author for Excel is also available in the Japanese (Nihongo) language. X-Author application support is currently provided for:
Actual data remains as in your environment.
You can choose the language to use in X-Author for Excel.
Go to Settings > Settings and set the language preference as English or Japanese. After changing this option, restart Microsoft Excel.
